designs.name: Wall model
designs.note: Fixed on the kitchen wall. 9 litre tank.

designs.name: Under the sink
designs.note: Hidden inside the cabinet. Only a tap on top. 7 litre tank.

designs.name: Table top
designs.note: Kept on the kitchen platform. No drilling. 8 litre tank.

water.name: Corporation water (PMC / PCMC)
water.note: Soft water. Your RO unit handles it fully.

water.name: Borewell water
water.note: Hard, salty water. Your RO unit brings it down. Adding minerals back is a good idea.

water.name: Tanker or mixed water
water.note: Water changes every day. Your RO + UV handles both.

options.name: Post carbon filter
options.note: Makes the water taste better after the tank.

options.name: Copper + Zinc filter
options.note: Adds copper and zinc to the water.

options.name: Mineral filter
options.note: Adds good minerals back to the water.

options.name: Separate alkaline tank with its own tap
options.note: A second tank and tap that gives alkaline water on its own.
